name: BNA Core Banking Migration
description: Migration of legacy core banking system to a modern microservices architecture using Java Spring Boot. Implemented real-time transaction processing, account management, and regulatory reporting modules. Migrated 2 million customer records from legacy Oracle Forms to new REST-based platform.
outcomes: Successfully migrated 100% of banking operations with zero downtime. Transaction processing speed improved by 60%. System handles 50,000 transactions per day.

name: Tunisie Telecom Customer Portal
description: Development of a modern self-service customer portal for Tunisie Telecom subscribers. Features include account management, bill payment, plan selection, usage monitoring, and support ticket management. Responsive design supporting mobile and desktop.
outcomes: Portal serves 500,000+ subscribers. Reduced call center volume by 35% through self-service features. 4.2/5 user satisfaction rating.

name: CNSS Social Security Platform
description: Development of a comprehensive social security management platform for CNSS. Handles employer declarations, employee registration, benefits calculation, and payment processing. Integration with national identity systems and banking networks.
outcomes: Platform processes 200,000 monthly declarations. Automated 80% of previously manual workflows. Reduced processing time from 15 days to 3 days.

name: Groupe Poulina ERP Integration
description: SAP S/4HANA implementation and integration for Groupe Poulina covering finance (FI/CO), materials management (MM), and sales distribution (SD) modules. Custom ABAP reports, Fiori applications, and integration with legacy inventory systems.
outcomes: Unified financial and supply chain operations across 12 subsidiaries. Real-time inventory visibility. 25% reduction in procurement cycle time.

name: STEG Smart Metering Dashboard
description: Development of a real-time smart metering dashboard for STEG to monitor electricity and gas consumption across Tunisia. IoT data ingestion pipeline, real-time analytics, anomaly detection, and interactive visualization dashboards.
outcomes: Monitors 100,000+ smart meters in real-time. Anomaly detection reduced energy theft by 15%. Operational visibility improved from monthly to real-time.

name: Ministry of Health Records System
description: Digital health records management system for the Tunisian Ministry of Health. Centralized patient records, appointment scheduling, prescription management, and inter-hospital data exchange. HIPAA-aligned data security.
outcomes: Deployed across 25 public hospitals. Digitized 3 million patient records. Inter-hospital referral time reduced from days to minutes.

name: BIAT Mobile Banking App
description: Cross-platform mobile banking application for BIAT using Flutter. Features include account balance, transfers, bill payments, card management, biometric authentication, and QR code payments.
outcomes: 150,000+ downloads in first 3 months. 4.5/5 app store rating. 40% of customers adopted mobile banking.

name: Ooredoo CRM Migration
description: Migration from legacy CRM to Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud for Ooredoo Tunisia. Custom Apex development, Lightning component creation, data migration of 2 million customer records, and integration with billing systems.
outcomes: Unified customer view for 3 million subscribers. Sales cycle reduced by 20%. Customer service resolution time improved by 30%.

name: CNSS Data Analytics Platform
description: Big data analytics platform for CNSS to analyze social security trends, fraud detection, and predictive modeling. Built on Apache Spark with interactive Tableau dashboards for decision makers.
outcomes: Identified 12% fraudulent declarations through ML models. Executive dashboards used by 50+ decision makers. Processing time for annual reports reduced from weeks to hours.

name: BNA Cybersecurity Audit
description: Comprehensive cybersecurity audit and penetration testing for BNA banking infrastructure. Included vulnerability assessment, network penetration testing, web application security testing, ISO 27001 gap analysis, and security policy recommendations.
outcomes: Identified and remediated 47 critical vulnerabilities. Achieved ISO 27001 readiness. Security posture score improved from 45% to 85%.

name: Tunisie Telecom DevOps Pipeline
description: Implementation of end-to-end DevOps pipeline for Tunisie Telecom development teams. CI/CD with Jenkins and GitLab CI, containerization with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, and monitoring with Prometheus/Grafana.
outcomes: Deployment frequency increased from monthly to daily. Build time reduced by 70%. Zero-downtime deployments achieved.

name: Poulina Supply Chain Portal
description: Web-based supply chain management portal for Groupe Poulina. Real-time inventory tracking, supplier management, purchase order workflows, and logistics dashboard. Integration with SAP MM module.
outcomes: Real-time visibility across 200+ suppliers. Order processing time reduced by 40%. Inventory accuracy improved to 98%.

name: STEG GIS Mapping System
description: Geographic Information System for STEG to manage and visualize the electricity and gas distribution network. Interactive web maps, spatial analysis tools, network topology management, and field crew dispatching.
outcomes: Mapped 100% of distribution network (50,000+ km). Field crew dispatch time reduced by 50%. Fault isolation time improved from hours to minutes.

name: BIAT Regulatory Reporting
description: Regulatory compliance and reporting system for BIAT to meet Central Bank of Tunisia requirements. Automated generation of regulatory reports (COREP, FINREP), data quality checks, and audit trail management.
outcomes: 100% compliance with Central Bank reporting requirements. Report generation time reduced from 5 days to 4 hours. Zero regulatory penalties since deployment.
